name: spotify
description: Spotify-specific actions only: open Spotify, play a playlist/track by name, or adjust Spotify's OWN volume (per-app — does not touch the Windows master volume). For simple transport controls (play/resume, pause, next, previous, stop) and the WINDOWS master volume use the media_control tool instead.

tools.name: spotify_control
tools.description: Spotify-specific actions. Use for: open Spotify (action='open'), play a playlist by name (action='play_playlist' with name=<playlist name>), play a track/song by name (action='play_track' with query=<song name>), and control Spotify's OWN volume — volume_up, volume_down, volume_set (with value=0-100), mute. Do NOT use for play/pause/next/previous/stop or the Windows master volume — those go to media_control.

action.description: open | play_playlist | play_track | volume_up | volume_down | volume_set | mute
